brief:
Four Palestinians were killed and several others injured Saturday in a series of Israeli ceasefire violations across the Gaza Strip, medical sources in Gaza reported. The attacks struck multiple locations including Khan Younis, Rafah, Gaza City, and the Jabalia refugee camp, according to IMEMC News.

The deaths represent a continuation of hostilities despite existing ceasefire agreements between the parties. The incidents marked at least the second reported wave of violations in recent days, though specific details about each attack—including the circumstances and identities of the deceased—remained unclear. Medical officials said additional Palestinians sustained injuries in the strikes, though exact casualty figures were not immediately available.
